The '''''Madersim''''' was an [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dulios]] of the Royal Security Forces tasked an RSF [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with escorting the ''Madersim'' in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG:RtRM" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' {{1st}}
